newsitem.title: USA: Bell Atlantic, DSC sign three-year purchase deal.
newsitem.headline: Bell Atlantic, DSC sign three-year purchase deal.

text.p: DSC Communications Corp Thursday announced signing a multi-year, multi- million dollar agreement with Bell Atlantic Corp for the purchase of telecommunications equipment.
The announcement was made shortly after the two companies announced the settlement of a $1.6 billion law suit against Lucent Technologies Inc. The terms were not disclosed.
"We are very pleased with the settlement of this litigation against Lucent and with the purchase commitment from Bell Atlantic," James L. Donald, chairman and CEO of DSC said.

The agreement provides a minimum of ongoing business with Bell Atlantic from 1998 to 2001 and is "valued at a significant multiple of the existing level of business" between the two companies, a DSC statement read.
DSC reported that its shipments of products to Bell Atlantic represented $120 million in 1996 and $105 million in 1995.
